_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in the values. config.json is git-ignored so your token stays private.
_guild_id_help: Right-click your Discord server icon (with Developer Mode on) -> Copy Server ID.
_admin_role_help: Members with this role (or Administrator permission) may run /setup, /remove, /rename and /close-month.
_timezone_help: IANA timezone name. Used to decide when 'Friday' and 'last day of month' happen.
_overview_hour_help: Hour (0-23, local to timezone above) at which the Friday overview auto-posts.
_contested_margin_help: Points gap within which a member vs their top rival counts as a 'contested' (yellow) race.
_min_matches_help: Matches a member needs to be Hero-eligible. Set to 0 if you don't track matches.
_log_channel_help: Channel ID for the bot's master log (errors + status changes). 0 disables it.
